items.title: Oitij-jo x Whitechapel Gallery
items.summary: Join the Whitechapel Gallery for an evening programme of music, film and food curated by Oitij-jo, following a day of performances and workshops celebrating British Bengali arts and culture on Petticoat Lane. Oitij-jo is dedicated to providing creative collaborations and platforms to enhance British/Bangla engagement with wider global, national and local urban and rural communities.

items.title: ‘Dhakai Jamdani the Pride’
items.summary: Learn the process of naturally dyed yarms and weaving the simplest of Jamdani motifs. Come and create memories with a member of the your family through a series of workshops at House of Annetta as part of the High Streets Heritage Action Zone Cultural Programme.
